summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement (SPA) with an institutional investor for up to $36 million in pre-paid purchases over two years, with a 6% original issue discount (maximum balance $38.16M). An initial $3.498M tranche was funded. The company may settle by issuing Class A shares at 50% of market price (with $0.10 floor) under its existing F-3 shelf, with a 7% interest rate and 120% cash prepayment option. Univest Securities acted as placement agent. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation; no change of control, premium, or strategic event is indicated.
